outline:
本課程之目的在訓練學生，使學生熟悉經常使用之統計方法與理論，能利用已知之資料整理、分析未知之現象，打好修習其他相關學科之基礎。課程內容包括：機率理論、推定、假設檢定、迴歸分析、變異數分析等。
The purpose of this course is to train student and to provide a background in the theory and methodology of general statistical issues. Topics include probability theory, inference, hypothesis testing, regression analysis and variance analysis.
schedule:
1 Introduction to Probability Chapter 1.1-1.2
2 Introduction to Probability Chapter 1.3-1.6
3 Discrete Distributions Chapter 2.1-2.2
4 Discrete Distributions Chapter 2.3-2.4
5 Discrete Distributions Chapter 2.5-2.6
6 Continuous Distributions Chapter 3.1-3.2
7 Continuous Distributions Chapter 3.3-3.5
8 Continuous Distributions & Recapitulation Chapter 3.6-3.7
9 Midterm Exam in class
10 Review of Midterm Exam
11 Bivariate Distributions Chapter 4.1-4.2
12 Bivariate Distributions Chapter 4.3-4.4
13 Distributions of Functions of Random Variables Chapter 5.1-5.2
14 Distributions of Functions of Random Variables Chapter 5.3-5.4
15 Distributions of Functions of Random Variables Chapter 5.5-5.7
16 Recapitulation & Homework Assignments Review
17 Final Exam in class
